events.label: founding
events.text: Luftflotte 5 was formed in Hamburg for the invasion of Norway.

evidence.quote: It was formed 12 April 1940 in Hamburg for the invasion of Norway

events.text: Erhard Milch took command of Luftflotte 5.

evidence.quote: It transferred to Oslo , Norway on 24 April 1940

events.text: Erhard Milch left command of Luftflotte 5.
Hans-Jürgen Stumpff took command of Luftflotte 5.

events.label: operation
events.text: Luftflotte 5 attacked northern England during the Battle of Britain.

evidence.quote: On 15 August 1940 the Luftwaffe mounted the largest number of sorties of the Battle of Britain . Luftflotte 5 attacked the north of England .

events.label: founding
events.text: Second air district, LgK Finnland, was formed around Rovaniemi.

evidence.quote: In 1941 , with the invasion of the Soviet Union and the entry of Finland into the war

events.text: Fighter forces in Norway placed under Jagdfliegerführer Norwegen command.

evidence.quote: From June 1941 fighter forces in Norway came under the separate command of Jagdfliegerführer Norwegen

events.label: reorganization
events.text: Ff Nord was divided into three separate commands.

evidence.quote: In June 1942 Ff Nord was divided into three separate commands

events.text: Hans-Jürgen Stumpff left command of Luftflotte 5.
Josef Kammhuber took command of Luftflotte 5.

events.label: reorganization
events.text: Luftflotte 5 formations reorganized; Nord Ost became Ff 3, Nord West became Ff 4.

evidence.quote: In 1944 these formations were reorganized again

events.text: Ground commands renamed: LgK Norwegen became K.G. in Norwegen, LgK Finnland became K.G. Finnland

evidence.quote: On the ground LgK Norwegen became Kommandierende General der Luftwaffe ( K.G. ) in Norwegen
In 1944 these formations were reorganized again

events.text: Josef Kammhuber left command of Luftflotte 5.

undated_mentions: Ff Lofoten reinforced with two bomber groups for maritime operations (summer of 1942)
